title: Slot recovery gate should check store emptiness, not hardcode is_empty=true
description: P3 (wave-3 review of worker6-eni9): lichend.rs slot recovery gate (~:1243) hardcodes is_empty=true where the trust-path equivalent (~:359) really checks entries().next().is_none(). A validly-sealed generation-1 store containing claims would be adopted and committed. Reachable only via sealing-seed (identity) compromise or coordinator bug (legit gen-1 stores are provisioned empty and every accepted claim bumps generation), so defense-in-depth only. Fix: perform the real emptiness check on the loaded verifier state.
